context: A mom soothes her young son after a tough school morning
purpose: Teach: 瞳/斜め/今頃/抱く/癒さ/つくづく/到底/ツボ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おかえり翔。ほら、こっちおいで。お母さん、いっぱい抱くからね。
lines.en: Welcome home, Sho. Come here, let me give you lots of hugs.
lines.style: Warm, soft, slow tempo with maternal gentleness

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: …今頃、みんな給食食べてるんだろうな。僕だけ早退して、なんか嫌だよ。
lines.en: Everyone's probably eating lunch right about now. I'm the only one who left early, and it sucks.
lines.style: Quiet, downcast, slightly nasal child voice mumbling softly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっか…ねえ、お母さんの目見て。その瞳、ちょっと泣きそうだね。
lines.en: I see. Hey, look at Mom. Your eyes look a little teary, huh.
lines.style: Tender, near-whisper, kneeling-down register with care

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: けんちゃんがさ、斜めから変なこと言ってきて、もうクラス戻れないよ。
lines.en: Ken came at me sideways with something weird, and now I can't go back to class.
lines.style: Frustrated, voice cracking, on the verge of tears

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今日はもう到底無理。みんなの顔見るのが怖いんだもん。
lines.en: Today there's just no way. I'm scared to see everyone's faces.
lines.style: Small, trembling, almost swallowed mumble through sniffles

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: つくづく学校って疲れるよね。ちょっと足のツボ、ここ押してあげようか。
lines.en: School really wears you out, doesn't it. Here, let me press this spot on your foot.
lines.style: Lightly playful, trying to lift the mood with soft chuckle

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ……ふふ、くすぐったいよお母さん。なんか、ちょっと癒される。
lines.en: Hehe, that tickles, Mom. Somehow, it feels a little soothing.
lines.style: Small giggle breaking through tears, relieved and softer

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ね、笑った顔の方がずっと可愛いよ。今日はお母さんとゆっくり過ごそう。
lines.en: See, your smiling face is way cuter. Let's just take it easy together today.
lines.style: Reassuring, smiling through her voice, gentle warm finish
